additionalInfo: NOT a 24-hour facility. Founded in 1937 by the Sisters of the Precious Blood, managed by Caritas Hong Kong since 1993. Approximately 180 beds. Grade III Historic Building in Hong Kong. Does NOT provide A&E services; patients requiring casualty treatment will be transferred to a nearby HA hospital. The hospital is the first private hospital in Hong Kong to offer discounted surgical packages for public hospital patients. Walk-in accepted for general OPD; specialist OPD requires appointment. Maternity services available (reopened in 2009). MTR: Sham Shui Po Station Exit D2 (5-minute walk). Undergoing redevelopment in partnership with Parkway Medical Services (IHH Healthcare) under a 2024 MOU. Accepts cash, EPS, Visa/Mastercard, UnionPay, WeChat Pay.
